messages.content: Before I book Raleigh, can you make sure the Friday flight and Marriott dates actually line up? I also want to settle whether we should keep the rental car just for the Saturday wedding.

They line up as planned: fly Denver to RDU Friday, May 2, departing around 5:45 a.m. and arriving around 11:05 a.m.; stay at the Raleigh Marriott City Center Friday and Saturday nights; then check out Sunday, May 4, before the 10:30 a.m. brunch and take the roughly 5:35 p.m. nonstop home. The early arrival leaves more than seven hours before the 6:30 p.m. dinner near Moore Square, even if the room is not ready and the hotel only stores your bags.
Good. What are the realistic choices for getting both of us to the ceremony near Cary at 4:00 Saturday and back downtown after the reception?

The practical choices are a rental car, rideshares in both directions, or a prearranged car service. From central Raleigh to the Cary area, allow roughly 25-35 minutes in ordinary traffic, but the exact venue address could change that. I would plan to leave the Marriott around 3:00 p.m. so you have time for parking and any traffic delay.
Compare the total trip cost, not just Saturday. The Marriott parking is supposed to be $30 a night.

For a Friday-to-Sunday rental, add the quoted rental total, about $60 for two hotel parking nights, fuel, and any airport fees not included in the quote. If the compact car is around $210-$250 all-in before parking and fuel, the trip transportation total would be roughly $285-$330. Rideshares would cover RDU to downtown Friday, downtown to Cary and back Saturday, and downtown to RDU Sunday. A reasonable planning range is about $130-$210 total, with the return after the reception carrying the greatest risk of surge pricing or a longer wait.
Could we rent only on Saturday downtown instead?

Possibly, but it depends on downtown office hours. Many neighborhood locations close early Saturday and may not accept a return after the reception, which could force a Sunday return and another parking night. You would also still need rideshares to and from RDU. It is worth checking, but it is not automatically cheaper or simpler.
And a scheduled car service? We don't know exactly when the reception ends.

A car service is most useful if you can set a pickup window or contact the driver when the reception is winding down. For the Cary round trip alone, it may cost roughly $180-$260, depending on the venue, waiting time, and gratuity. Adding airport rides would likely put it near or above the full rental-car total, though it avoids parking and driving after the reception.
That makes the rental sound easiest. Is there any timing problem with picking it up after the 11:05 arrival and returning it for the 5:35 flight?

No inherent timing problem. A pickup around noon Friday gives you ample time to reach the Marriott, leave bags, and be ready for dinner. On Sunday, leave brunch with enough time to collect luggage and depart downtown around 2:30 p.m.; returning the car near 3:15 p.m. should provide about two hours before departure. Confirm the rental counter hours and whether the quoted rate allows a return around that time without crossing into another rental day.
All right. Keep the airport rental. Give me one final itinerary and booking order, including the totals we already have.

Book the two nonstop tickets first after confirming the exact schedules and the $924 total for both travelers, including any bag and seat charges. Then reserve one room for two adults at the Raleigh Marriott City Center for May 2-4, confirming the stated $625 after-tax total, room configuration, cancellation deadline, and $30 nightly parking. Finally, reserve the compact car at RDU from about noon Friday until roughly 3:15 p.m. Sunday; verify the all-in rental price, counter hours, fuel terms, and additional-driver charge.
Please finish with the day-by-day version so I can book against it.

Friday, May 2: depart Denver around 5:45 a.m., arrive at RDU around 11:05 a.m., collect the rental car, and drive downtown. Leave luggage with the Marriott if the room is not ready, check in for two nights, and attend the 6:30 p.m. family dinner near Moore Square. Saturday, May 3: leave the hotel around 3:00 p.m. for the 4:00 p.m. ceremony near Cary, then drive back downtown after the reception. Sunday, May 4: check out, attend the 10:30 a.m. brunch, collect luggage, leave downtown around 2:30 p.m., return the car around 3:15 p.m., and take the nonstop departing RDU around 5:35 p.m. Before payment, verify the actual ceremony address and parking instructions as well as every flight, hotel, and rental detail listed above. Nothing has yet been purchased or reserved.
